en: Color postcard view over a town in a wide green valley with mountains in the background. In the foreground there is a river, fields, and a light-colored villa-like building. Flowering tree branches frame the upper right side of the image. The town is composed of mid‑rise buildings with red-tiled roofs stretching toward the foothills of a large mountain. The word "TRENTO." is printed at the top left of the image.
